layers.note: Shares the canopy with Douglas-fir on moist ground and fills the understory beneath it.

moisture.note: Commonest on moist to wet ground (seeps, stream bottoms, swamps, lower slopes); tolerates saturated soil better than Douglas-fir, but not standing water.

heat_load.note: Favours cool, moist aspects and shaded ravines; scarce on hot south-west slopes.

elevation_m.note: Lowlands to about 1,200 m in western Washington.

max_slope_deg.note: Grows on slopes but most often on benches, bottoms and toe slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Very shade tolerant: seedlings and saplings persist under closed canopy.
